subject: ftglyph-malformed-slot-and-class-facade
purpose: Shared malformed glyph-slot and glyph-class vocabulary for public ftglyph error parity rows. Runnable cases must still have explicit Rust, C ABI, WASM, and pinned C oracle routes before they count as real parity.

cases.required_route: Load a real outline glyph, corrupt its public FT_Outline contours pointer while n_contours remains non-zero, and compare FT_Err_Invalid_Outline plus caller-handle preservation across pinned C, Rust FFI, C ABI, and WASM ABI.

probes.description: Pass a non-null FT_Glyph* whose referenced glyph is null.
Pass a glyph record with a null library and otherwise callable class.
Pass a glyph record with a null clazz pointer.
Pass a glyph class without a prepare hook.

cases.expected_public_behavior: FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap returns the exact pinned C public FT_Error for each early invalid argument path and preserves the caller glyph handle class.

A malformed owned outline forces the renderer error after replacement allocation. Rust, C ABI, WASM, and pinned C must return the exact error, retain the caller's original handle, clean up the untransferred replacement, undo origin translation for destroy=false, and retain FreeType's applied origin for destroy=true.

cases.required_route: Synthetic glyph-slot formats and malformed SVG payloads reach the same FT_Get_Glyph class hooks and cleanup paths as pinned C, with exact output-pointer and allocation/free observations.

Fail the target allocation, fail bitmap payload copying after target allocation, and reject a zero-length SVG source after target allocation; every lane must report exact errors, a null target, and partial-target destruction events.
Synthetic glyph-slot advances around the exclusive 16.16 conversion bounds with cleanup observation across all ABI layers.
Glyph record/class identity probes for valid outline, bitmap, optional SVG, and bad null-class records without exposing private class addresses.
